test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 23 Jan 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.
solution:
The correct answer is **"witnessed."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The verb **'witnessed'** means to see or observe something happening. (किसी चीज़ को घटित होते हुए देखना या निरीक्षण करना)

 
 
• **Example**:* "I **witnessed**__ the accident on the highway yesterday."*
 
 
 
• It is the most appropriate option to fill in the blank, as it fits the context of the sentence.
 
• The correct answer is option 3.
 
• Correct passage:

A beautiful spectacle for anyone to __behold__ would be the crowds that throng to see the Indian cricket team playing, whether it be in India or in other parts of the globe. This __undoubtedly__ is the occasion where the spirit of oneness is all pervasive. India with all its diversity __could__ be seen either rejoicing or moaning depending on the sway of the game __being__ watched. Unity in diversity is __**witnessed**__ in all its glory.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Option 1, redressed**: means to correct or remedy a problem. (सही करना, सुधार करना, ठीक करना)

 
 
• **Example**: *"The company **redressed**__ the customer's complaint by offering a refund."*
 
 
 
• **Option 2, terraced**: means to create a series of flat areas on a hillside. (किसी पहाड़ी पर समतल क्षेत्रों की श्रृंखला बनाना)
 __
 
• **Example**: *"The farmers **terraced**__ the land to prevent soil erosion."*
 
 
 
• **Option 4, procured**: means to obtain something through effort or action. (प्रयास या क्रिया द्वारा कुछ प्राप्त करना)
 __
 
• **Example**: *"The manager **procured**__ a new printer for the office."*
